senses.gloss: 1. नि-धन mfn. (for 2. See col. 3) having no property, poor, L.
2. नि-˚ध॑न (for 1. See col. 2) n. (m. only, Hariv. 4846; g. अर्धर्चादि) settling down, residence or place of r˚, domicile, receptacle, AV.; Suśr.; BhP.
conclusion, end, death, destruction, loss, annihilation, Mn.; Var.; MBh. &c.
(in music) the concluding passage of a Sāman which is sung in chorus
any finale, AV.; TS.; Br. &c.
N. of the 8th mansion, Var.
race, family, L.
नि-˚ध॑न m. the head of a family, W.
नि-˚ध॑ना (आ), f. pl. N. of partic. verses or formulas, Kauś.
नि-˚धा॑न n. putting or laying down, depositing, keeping, preserving, KātyŚr.; MBh. &c.
laying aside (cf. दण्ड-न्˚)
placing (the sacrificial fire), KātyŚr.
place for depositing anything, receptacle (rarely m.; ifc. f(ई). ; cf. गर्भ-न्˚), RV. &c. &c.
a place of cessation or rest, W.
anything laid up, a store, hoard, treasure (esp. the t˚ of Kubera), Mn.; Mṛcch.; Ragh. &c. (-ता f., Jātakam.)
नि-˚धा॑न mfn. containing anything (gen.) in itself, TĀr.
नि-धन—ता f. poverty, Mṛcch. i, 13; Hit. i, 128.
नि-˚धान—ता f., Jātakam.
2. नि-˚धा॑ f. a net or snare, RV.
नि-˚धन—काम n. N. of sev. Sāmans, TāṇḍBr.; Lāṭy.
नि-˚धन—कारिन् mfn. causing death, destroying, W.
निधन—कृत mfn. put to an end, destroyed, JaimUp.
नि-˚धन—क्रिया f. a funeral ceremony, Hariv.
नि-˚धन—पति m. lord of the end or of destruction, TĀr.
नि-˚धन—भूत mfn. (in music) forming a finale, Lāṭy.
नि-˚ध॑न—वत् (˚ध॑न-), mfn. having a finale, VS.; TāṇḍBr. &c.
निधन—वाद m. a word used as Nidhana, Lāṭy.; Drāhy.
नि-˚धन—सूत्र n. N. of wk.
नि-˚धन—सूत्र-वृत्ति f. N. of wk.
नि-˚ध˚नोत्तम m. N. of Śiva, R.
नि-˚धा॑—पति (˚धा॑-), m. possessor or bearer of snares, ib.
नि-˚धातव्य mfn. to be put down or deposited or concealed or delivered or directed towards, Mn.; MBh. &c.
नि-˚धातृ॑ m. one who lays down i.e. imprints or leaves (a footmark), RV. v, 30, 2.
नि॑-˚धातोस् (नि॑-), abl. inf. (with आ) to the end, until death, RV.
नि-˚धा॑नी f. N. of a formula, TBr.; ĀpŚr.
नि-˚धान—कुम्भ m. a pot or jar containing a treasure, Sāh.
नि-˚धा˚नी-√ कृ to pile up, Hcar.
नि-˚धा˚नेश m. ‘lord of treasure’, a Yakṣa, Śatr.
नि-˚धानक mfn. g. ऋश्यादि.
नि-˚धान्य᳙ mfn. fit for being laid or put down, RV.
नि-˚धापक m. (fr. Caus.) one who causes a weapon to be put down (?)
burnt timber
charcoal
the castor oil plant, W.
नि-˚धाप्य ind. (fr. Caus.) having caused to be placed or fixed in, having installed or appointed, MW.
नि-˚धाय ind. having fixed or placed in or on
with मनसि, fixing or laying up in the mind
reflecting, Hit.
नि-˚धायम् See घृत-न्˚.
नि-˚धि॑ m. setting down or serving up (food, &c.), RV. i, 183, 4 &c.
the bottom of the Ukhā, ŚBr.
a place for deposits or storing up, a receptacle (esp. अपां निधि, r˚ of waters, the ocean, sea, also N. of a Sāman; कलानां न्˚, the full moon), MBh.; Kāv. &c.

a store, hoard, treasure, RV. &c. &c. (in later language esp. the divine treasures belonging to Kubera, nine of which are enumerated, viz. Padma, Mahāpadma, Śaṅkha, Makara, Kacchapa, Mukunda, Nanda, Nīla and Kharva, they are also personified as attendants either of Kubera or of Lakṣmī; cf. निधि-दत्त and -पालित below)
the sea, L.
(with दैव) the science of chronology, ChUp. vii, 1, 2 (Śaṃk.)
N. of a partic. medic. plant (= जीविका), L.
a kind of perfume (= नलिका), L.
नि-धि॑ See under नि-धा.
नि-˚धि—गुह्य-काधिप m. ‘lord of the treasures and Guhyakas’, Kubera, Kir. v, 20
नि-˚धि—गोप॑ m. guardian of t˚, ŚBr.
नि-˚धि—दत्त m. N. of a merchant, Kathās.
नि-˚धि—दीपिका f. N. of wk.
नि-˚धि—नाथ m. ‘lord of t˚’, N. of Kubera, L.
of an author, Cat.
नि-˚धि—प m. = -गोप, Mn.; MBh.
any guardian or protector (as यज्ञस्य, वेदस्य), ĀśvGṛ. i, 22, 21
नि-˚धि—पा॑ m. (AV.; TBr.) guardian of treasure
नि-˚धि॑—पति (˚धि॑-), m. lord of t˚, AV.; VS.
N. of Kubera, Hariv.
of a rich merchant, Vet.
नि-˚धि—पति-दत्त m. N. of a merchant, Daś.
नि-˚धि—पाल m. (MBh.) guardian of treasure
नि-˚धि—पालित m. N. of a merchant, Daś.
नि-˚धि—प्रभु m. lord of treasures, N. of Kubera, MW.
नि-˚धि—भृत् m. bearer of t˚ id., Dharmaśarm.
नि-˚धि—म॑त् mfn. containing t˚ or forming a store, abundant, RV.
नि-˚धि—मय mf(ई)n. consisting of t˚, Hcar.
नि-˚धि—राम m. N. of an author, Cat.
नि-˚धि—वाद m. the art of finding t˚, Kād.
नि-˚धि—वास m. ‘place of t˚’, N. of a town, L.
नि-˚धीश m. (-त्व n., R.) ‘lord of t˚’, N. of Kubera
नि-˚धीश—त्व n., R.
नि-˚धीश्वर m. (Dharmaśarm.) ‘lord of t˚’, N. of Kubera
नि-˚ध्य्-अर्थिन् mfn. seeking t˚, MW.
नि-˚धेय mfn. to be placed in or on, to be deposited or kept or preserved, Hariv.; Car. &c.
नि-धारय॑ See नि-धृ.
नि-˚धारय॑ mfn. establishing or having established (acc.), RV. viii, 41, 4.

नि-√ 2. धाव् Ā. धावते, (aor. अधाविष्ट), to rub into one's person, TS. ;
to press one's self on, cling to (loc.), RV.
नि-˚धुवन n. shaking, trembling, agitation, L.
sexual intercourse, Gīt.; Hāsy.
sport, play, L.
नि-˚धृति m. N. of a son of Vṛṣṇi, AgP.
नि-ध्यप्ति f. reflection, philosophical meditation, L.
नि-˚ध्यात mfn. meditated or thought on Vajracch.
नि-˚ध्यान n. intuition, seeing, sight, L.
नि-ध्रुव m. N. of a man, Pravar. : pl. his descendants, ĀśvŚr. (cf. नैध्रुव, ˚वि).
नि॑-ध्रुवि mfn. constant, persevering, faithful, RV.
नि॑-ध्रुवि m. N. of a Kāśyapa and author of RV. ix, 63; Anukr.
नि-√ ध्वंस् Caus. -ध्वसयति, to scatter, overthrow, destroy, RV. x, 73, 6.
नि-ध्वान m. (√ 2. ध्वन्) sound, L.
नी—ध्र See नीध्र.
नीध्र n. (नि + √ धृ ?) the eaves of a roof, Rājat.
a wood, L.
the circumference of a wheel, L.
the moon or the lunar mansion Revatī, L. (cf. नीव्र).
